Project-07 : Bearing Wear Inspection Client: Honda Analytical Tools & Environment: Python,VLLM,, LLM, Computer Vision. Duration: June 2024 till date
Description : Developed a LLM based model to summarize and create a maintenance report along with Computer vision model to identify type of defects and deploy it in production following Mlops cycle using AWS services.Object detection model is built to identify wear type.Metadata information extracted from above model is used for template creation. LLM model like GPT3.5 is used to analyze the data to create structured data which is then compared with the above template to provide maintenance and summary report.
Project-06: SDK Development for Multiple Edge devices. Client : Product Job Role : Developed an Evaluation Application Softwares On GPU : Python, C/C++ Programming , Pytorch , Mxnet , Tensorflow, ONNX ,CV and other Machine Learning related Libraries, AWS-IOT-CORE, S3, Cross compilation
Description: Prepare the Conversion Scripts for Multiple Models for multiple edge devices and create payload. Evaluation application using Factory Design Pattern runs inference to multiple models in multiple edge devices. Connect Multiple edge devices to AWS IOT CORE with different topics and communicate with the device to run the evaluation and send the results to S3 Storage.
Project-05: Model Compression and Quantization For Porting On Edge. Client : Product Job Role : Developed an Neural Network Models for Detection and Applying Compression and Quantization Techniques Softwares On GPU : Python, C/C++ Programming , Pytorch , Mxnet , Tensorflow, ONNX ,CV and other Machine Learning related Libraries.
Description: Trained Tensorflow and Pytorch models for Publicly Available Datasets and Applied Compression and Quantization to improve the Performance and Accuracy in Qualcomm rb5 , Xilinx ,Ambarella cv25 EVK Development boards.
Project-04: Face Detection and Face Recognition On Edge. Client : Confidential Job Role : Developed Neural Network Models for Face Detection and Face Recognition and Deployed in Battery Based Edge computing Device For Smart Policing . Softwares On GPU : Python, C/C++ Programming , Pytorch , Mxnet , Tensorflow, ONNX ,CV and other Machine Learning related Libraries.
Description: Explored and tested several face detection and face recognition architectures on GPU to zeroin on models having best accuracy and speed. Created a pipeline for video face recognition consisting of face detection (FD), face alignment (FA), face tracking (FT) and face recognition(FR)
Project-03:Collecting benchmarking from Ambarella Edge Device. Client : Safely-you Job Role : Computer Vision Engineer Framework : PyTorch/Onnx
Description: Customers based on their requirements identified a few pretrained models and wanted to evaluate the models on Edge Device Ambarella CV22/CV25 to collect the benchmarking parameters like performance.. Responsibilities:
Model conversion from PyTorch to ONNX and further device compatibility model generation. ● Developed complete inference application running on CV22/CV25 with live camera and static images. Inference pipeline setup, pre-processing, post-processing on ARM.

Project-02: Detecting defective solar panels and wind blades using Drone images. Client : Greenko Job Role : Developed an Django application and build object detection and image classification models using Deep learning and deploy in the production. Technology algorithms,MySql.
: Python, Keras, Tensorflow, Deep
learning, Machine
learning,image processing
Description: Solution avoids the manual inspection of solar panels and wind blades by using IR camera enabled drones and RGB camera enabled drones respectively and detect anomalies (dirt, shade, glass breakage, etc., in solar panels and , laminate damage, detachment of collar blade, paint erosion etc., in WTG blades).
Project-01: Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) Client : Ace Urban Job Role : Developed an Django application and build object detection models using Deep learning and deploy in the production. Technology algorithms,MySql
: Python, Tensorflow, OpenCV, deep
learning, Machine
learning ,image processing
Description: Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) is a technology that uses advanced image processing and optical character recognition on RTSP (IP) camera live streams/images to read vehicle registration plates in real time to create vehicle location data.
